This application provides a wearable device which includes a screen, a first electrode, a second electrode, and a circuit board. The screen and the second electrode are mounted on a housing, the first electrode is connected to the screen and does not shield a display region of the screen, and the first electrode and the second electrode are electrically connected by using the circuit board. In a thickness direction of the wearable device, the first electrode has a first surface, the second electrode has a second surface, and the first surface and the second surface are used to contact a human body. Such a design can effectively reduce impact of the first electrode on the display region of the screen.
